title: Maximize Sum of Device Ratings
summary: Input is a rectangular units matrix: m devices initially have n units each. Rating is minimum unit capacity, or zero when empty. Any device can be used as a source at most once, transferring exactly one current unit to any different device. Receiving is unlimited, including after acting as a source, and consumes no source allowance. Maximize total final rating; doing nothing is allowed.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
clarification: There is no receiver slot limit and no obligation to preserve each receiver's rating. A transfer may reduce one rating while increasing the total. Units are not discarded. Their capacities are attributes of individual units, not storage limits.
questionResolution: Specific CLAUDE-QUESTIONS.md question answered; source confidence recorded separately.
